connection_hint: Registered connections are shared with AI Advisor. Reports selects its own connection. Editing a connection affects every feature using it.
interval_hint: The interval applies to AI Crew as a whole, in real time even while paused. Timing varies and crew members may remain silent.
targets_hint: Choose units and press Apply to generate names and personalities together. Only current formation leaders and standalone units report. Crew and ON/OFF selections stay with each unit when formations change.
empty_history: No reports yet. Choose a connection in Settings, then enable reporting units.
error.connection_required: Choose a Reports connection before enabling a unit.
error.connection_missing: The selected connection no longer exists. Choose another connection in Settings.
error.provider_unavailable: This connection adapter does not support Reports.
error.settings_invalid: Check the interval (1-7 minutes) and notification settings.
error.invalid_response: The AI returned an invalid report. Reporting was stopped for the affected units.
error.too_large: The report input is too large.
error.unexpected_error: Reports encountered an error. See the log for details.
